peoples_entry.name: Bandits & Outlaw Confederacies
peoples_entry.note: Regionally differentiated frontier outlaws across Krator's four outlaw corridors — Boatmurder dry-sea hulk-cutters & Matok wreckers (`dam_basins`), Catch/Mid-Basin litham & jezail raiders (`arid_corridors`), Broken-Stair highwaymen & mutinous legion deserters (`imperial_highways`), and spiked-salvage mountain reivers (`highland_passes`) — plus four signature named outlaw confederacies: BF-03 Nazar Maroon Chain-Breakers, BF-06 Badland Glass-Eater Retort-Raiders, BF-09 Siphon-Pit Fume-Gangs, and BF-10 The Unsacrificed.
